description:
Newly Built A+ rated Detached Home for rent � Rush.
DNG McKenna Healy are pleased to bring this beautiful newly constructed A rated detached home to the rental market in Rush.

This bright and spacious property offers modern, comfortable living throughout, with a generous open-plan kitchen and living space at the heart of the home. The kitchen is finished to a high standard with integrated appliances, ample storage and a breakfast bar.

The property also benefits from excellent energy efficiency, underfloor heating, modern bathrooms and quality finishes throughout.

Outside, there is a large private garden, private driveway and generous side access, providing plenty of parking and outdoor space.

Located on Sandy Road, the property is within easy reach of Rush town centre, local schools, beaches, shops and sporting facilities. Rush & Lusk train station and excellent road links to Dublin are also nearby.

A superb modern rental home in a popular coastal location.
